issues: Camera orientation and full-body visibility have not been evaluated.

summary.headline: 1 completed push-up reps observed. Scores are not available yet.

limitations: Synthetic one-rep UI example generated from authored geometry. No matching video or camera measurement exists.

Body-line angle is the sample median of raw 2D shoulder-hip-ankle angles from rep start through completion. It is not a form score, cannot distinguish hip sag from pike, and can hide brief deviations. Camera orientation is not validated.
2D elbow angles use supplied landmarks; their camera origin cannot be verified.
Use a side view. Camera orientation is not validated; angles are not calibrated 3D.
Uncalibrated push-up rules count observed extension-flexion-extension cycles. Shallow, fast, or interrupted attempts may not count; this is not a form judgment.
Scores, form issues, and automatic exercise recognition are not implemented. The exercise is a user selection. Empty issues do not establish good form.
Uses the left elbow throughout this set (first usable side; left wins ties). Three-sample median smoothing and phase confirmation delay event timestamps.

Elbow excursion is the observed 2D maximum minus minimum from confirmed descent through completion, not a calibrated full range-of-motion score. Time to/from minimum splits the counted interval at its first lowest angle; it includes pauses and confirmation delay, not isolated lowering/lifting time.
